maria_g: Heads-up: planning a coordinated wave tonight 22:00-23:30 UTC. Sequence will be api -> runtime -> console -> router. This is within the quiet window. Please call out any hard blockers or pinned variants now.

alex_k: Quick status: api v2.0.1 (sha: sha-api-7f3) passed canary in staging. No DB migrations.

lee: Runtime team note: runtime v3.1.2 (quantized) requires kernel flag 'kv-compat' enabled on the router. If router is on older build it will reject requests. We need the router pinned to accept header X-Runtime-Version=v3.1 or fallback to router-legacy.

samir: Console side is a small toggle + release notes drafted (https://docs/redwood/release/notes/patch-321). No schema changes. Will push console config after runtime canary.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled wave at 22:10 UTC. Sequence: api -> runtime -> console -> router. Canary: 5m per service. Autocomplete rollback: true.

alex_k: Command I'm going to run (dry-run output):
```bash
# start orchestrated wave
deploybot start --wave=orch-8754 --seq api=sha-api-7f3,runtime=sha-rt-3.1.2,console=sha-ui-21,router=sha-router-11 --canary 5m --rb true
```

tess: Ops ask: can we route initial canary traffic to eu region only for first 10m? That reduces blast radius. Also add 1% traffic for canary.

alex_k: Ack, will set region=eu for canary.

lee: Router compatibility check: router-11 needs header whitelist updated. If we can't update router in-time, fallback plan = pin runtime to v3.0.x compatible runtime binary (sha-rt-3.0.9) and hold router changes.

samir: Console config: set FEATURE_BETA=false during canary to avoid UI toggles. I'll update the config before runtime promotion.

ops-monitor: smoke tests on staging (api+runtime+console) passed:
```
INFO  smoke: 12/12 checks OK
INFO  p99 latency api: 120ms
INFO  p99 latency runtime: 180ms
```

maria_g: Rollback rules (short):
- Trigger immediate rollback if error rate > 1% for 3 consecutive minutes
- Or p99 latency > 2s sustained for 3 min
- Or 10% drop in throughput vs baseline
If rollback triggered, reply "rollback" and deploybot will run the rollback sequence for that wave.

alex_k: I'll be on-call and watching metrics. Tagged the runtime and router engineers.

deploybot: deploybot: ready to execute on approval. Will emit realtime events to #release-notifications.

maria_g: Final ask: everyone acknowledge if they can monitor at 22:00 UTC. If no reply by 21:45 UTC we'll postpone to next window.

lee: Ack.

samir: Ack.

tess: Ack.

alex_k: Ack.

ops-monitor: Monitoring hooks configured and alert policies set.

maria_g: Thanks — will post a short release note in #release-notifications when we start.
